metadata.title: Where to Start a New Playlist in Melivra | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
In Melivra’s Playlists screen, find New Playlist near the top. New smart playlist is a separate control under Smart Playlists.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator capture of Melivra 1.0.8+145 with repository-authored demonstration names, counts and original procedural cover art. No taps, playlist creation, saved results, track insertion, playback or speed demonstration is shown. This is not a live recording, and the video has no audio.
